descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在利马吃鸡肉 causa 后补画夹馅层的小菜单。
descriptions.en: A Lima chicken causa menu with the filling layer added.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在利马吃甜点时改好菜名留下的菜单纸。
descriptions.en: A Lima dessert menu with the dish’s spelling put right.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在赖蒙迪公园画的个人草稿，灯塔和椅子挤得太近。
descriptions.en: A personal Raimondi Park draft that crowds lighthouse and bench together.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在利马抄甜点名后自制的改字小纸。
descriptions.en: A homemade correction slip after writing a Lima dessert’s name.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使回想利马喷泉时做的纸书签，提醒自己合上本子先看。
descriptions.en: A paper bookmark made after Lima’s fountains, recalling a pause to look.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 亲手折的利马歇脚记忆卡，展开才看见长箭头。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded Lima memory card that opens to reveal a long arrow.
